ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModalId.helper: Enter the modal id to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

ModalDialogTitle.helper: Enter the modal dialog title to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

ModalContent.helper: Enter the text for modal content. Use short paragraphs so it is easy to read.

PrimaryButtonText.helper: Enter the primary button text to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

PrimaryButtonLink.helper: Optional. Enter the web address for the main button.

SecondaryButtonText.helper: Enter the secondary button text to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

SecondaryButtonLink.helper: Optional. Enter the web address for the second button.
